New module `athena_core::plan` turns each open request into a plan entry (goal, ladder rung, acceptance, open questions, dependencies, touched paths) and plans them together. Order is dependency waves, then ladder rung (top first), then age. Items in a wave with disjoint touched paths and no dependency form a parallel group. An item that names no path is never grouped. An entry missing goal, rung or acceptance is refused and reported, and a dependency loop is not scheduled. `drain` works items in plan order, one job at a time, and the report and CLI show the groups and refusals. Items with no plan entry keep their old place ahead of planned ones. `reading::plan_entry` builds entries from a reading once read, otherwise from the request's own words. New stop reason `Stop::Requested` and command `athena drain-stop`: it creates a file in the state directory that is checked before every job, so the current job is finished, landed and rated, no further job starts, and nothing is killed. The n2qb audit is a first slice: `plan::trace` maps a gap's text to a stage and `GapLog::fell` compares gaps per job before and after a change. Reading gaps from records and a role that proposes stage changes are stated as follow-up. README, roles-and-ladder design doc, CHANGELOG and new decision D105 are updated.
